diameterInterpretation: ADAM nonconvex reconstruction constrained by VLT/SPHERE images. Selected archive volume-equivalent diameter: 144 ±3 km. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

calibration.uncertaintyKind: Archive estimate of volume-equivalent diameter error; not a bound on local shape accuracy.
calibration.diameterSemantics: Volume-equivalent diameter in the selected DAMIT record; actual source publications and release differences are documented in selectionNotes.
calibration.limitations: The pinned mesh is an inverse model, not a directly sampled surface. No registered reflectance mosaic is supplied by this release; a neutral grid must mark unavailable imagery. Fine-scale craters, regolith and albedo are unresolved. Absolute rotational phase is illustrative. Select Vernazza et al. (2021) ADAM model 5913 constrained by VLT/SPHERE images. DAMIT D144 ±3 km differs from the publication summary 145 ±3 km because the summary can average ADAM/MPCD outputs when coverage exceeds 80%; the exact selected mesh has raw volume diameter 144.329. Keep the archive ADAM model separate from MPCD refinement. No albedo map is inferred from deconvolved disk images.
